key.name: swap-lr
key.description: ZMK assigns peripheral slot indices in pairing order, which is not guaranteed to map to physical left/right. Toggle this if your halves appear reversed in the panel.

key.name: hide-when-disconnected
key.summary: Hide indicator while keyboard is disconnected
key.description: When enabled, the panel indicator disappears entirely while no compatible dongle is found. When disabled, it stays visible with placeholder values.
